_notes: DeliveryPolicy v1. Per-target R2 cutover gate: while `cutover` is empty every gate evaluates to today's behavior (uploads proceed, prune deletes exactly as today). A target is cut over only when an entry {target {variant, flavor, platform}, evidence {receiptDigest, qualifiedAt}, preset} is present AND its evidence receipt still matches the current catalog (see scripts/delivery-cutover.py, which reuses scripts/contracts/targets.py). Group closure is NOT stored here — it is computed from iso_groups in .github/build-config.yml plus `cutover` (every LIVE + OFFLINE member target cut over). `retained` lists R2 object basenames (dated ISOs + sidecars) that prune-r2.yml must keep even after the 14d sweep.
